result:
**Verdict: PASS.** I reviewed DG1 round 9, frozen candidate `sha256:05915c32…591babd`, freeze commit `273d21f`. I found no new findings, and F-DG1-010 is verified closed.

**Candidate identity.** HEAD is `07f1a54`, one commit past the freeze commit `273d21f`. That extra commit only adds the round-9 assignments, the candidate manifest and `stages.json`, all of which the candidate hash excludes. I recomputed the candidate ID in the repo, in a full clone checked out at `273d21f`, and from the frozen manifest. All three match, so I proceeded rather than returning BLOCKED.

**F-DG1-010 (Low, non-mandatory; I raised it in round 8): closed.** The fix removes the cause rather than rewording it.
- The module lint is now default-deny. A `node:` import is allowed only if it is on a seven-item allow-list, and a `process.<member>` only if it is on a four-item allow-list. Anything a later Node version adds is denied automatically.
- The testkit header no longer says "exhaustive", "closed as found" or "pinned".
- Its only version mention, "production targets Node 24, the supported floor is Node 22.18+", matches `.nvmrc`, `engines`, the Dockerfile and ADR-0001.
- D-055 supersedes the old framing in D-053/D-054.
- I couldn't run the lint on Node 24, because this sandbox only has Node 20–22 and no network. The fixed check doesn't depend on the Node version, so that doesn't block the verification.

**No regression.** The only product change is two test files that are excluded from the build. The API contract, data model, i18n strings, design tokens and requirements register are unchanged. All results are from my own runs in a disposable clone, which I deleted afterwards:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Full unit suite | 294/294 |
| Architecture suite | 101/101 |
| My own over-reach probe | 4/4: real modules have zero violations, every `node:` import they use is allow-listed, normal module code is allowed, 15 loader/debug/exec routes are denied |
| Integration, run twice on fresh PostgreSQL 16 | 200/200 each run, zero 57P01 errors, no leftover databases |
| Live Arabic/English stack | 108/108 |
| no-CDN, OpenAPI lint, typecheck, eslint, prettier | all exit 0 |

The integration runs cover the close rule (refused with 422, citing G6), scoped access, sign-in/session routes and cursor pagination. The live run checks the same behaviour in the browser, plus provisional branding and Unknown shown instead of zero. I looked at the rendered screens directly (`ar-02-edit-no-closed.png` and `en-03-detail-audit.png`) and they show this correctly in both languages.

**Requirements.** The 8 assigned rows, and all 12 rows due at DG1, are IMPLEMENTED with every cited evidence file present. The 29 playbook, §15 and §16 rows that have a P1 increment but are due at a later gate are still SPECIFIED, so nothing over-claims. The 12 round-8 domain closures (F-DG1-001/002/003/004/005/006/105/007/008/207/009/210) still hold on this candidate. No Critical, High or mandatory finding is open.

**One observation, not a finding.** The default-deny lint also rejects harmless items such as `process.pid` and `node:events`. No module uses them today, and D-055 already says such items get reviewed and added deliberately when needed.

I wrote no verification for F-DG1-129 or F-DG1-213; they belong to the code-security and QA reviewers. I grant no business, Finance or IT approval, and product gate G6 does not imply DG7.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`. Evidence is under `test-evidence/DG1/domain/round-9/`; it validates against the schema and all 55 evidence references exist:
- `reviews/DG1/round-9/domain-reviewer.json`
- `reviews/DG1/round-9/domain-reviewer.verifications.json` (F-DG1-010 → CLOSED_VERIFIED)
- `reviews/DG1/round-9/domain-reviewer.md`
